about: Every effectiveness or cost number this repository publishes, as data. test/host/claims.test.ts validates this file and checks that the README's effectiveness section still quotes each published claim. The README is text that must carry these facts; it is not the source of them. Adding a third result means adding an entry here, which forces an n, a seat, a metric and a record before the test suite will accept it. Raw run data is not committed: the artifact policy deletes it and the cited issue keeps the method and the verdict.

metric.cache: cache read and cache write are reported separately and never folded into a total

rules: An issue or PR body making a cost claim owes the same n, seat and metric

claims.label: Transport
claims.claim: A fact learned in one session reaches a later session that provably cannot obtain it any other way
claims.n: 5 per arm, with the empty-store floor verified first
claims.measurement: empty store 0/5, the same store seeded 5/5
claims.estimator: pass count per arm, floor run before seeded run

claims.label: Reuse
claims.claim: A memory reduces the work on a task the agent already passes
claims.measurement: median of the six per-pair L2/L0 work ratios 0.91x, higher in 2 of 6; an unrelated memory 0.99x, higher in 3 of 6
claims.estimator: median of the six per-pair ratios, middle two averaged

retracted.why: two runs that started in different cache states, read as a saving
